input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with A machine learning system is designed to evaluate and compare physical appearance, providing assessments of beauty based on various criteria. The system aims to make unbiased judgments, considering diverse features and characteristics to determine aesthetic appeal. It seeks to provide a fair and impartial evaluation of physical attractiveness.
